Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:

O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.

O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.

Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.

Job Title: Application Support Engineer

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Role Description: The Application Support Engineer is responsible for administering and supporting the ticketing system, as well as providing operational support, maintenance, and lifecycle management for both SaaS (vendor-managed) and self-managed enterprise applications. This role ensures applications are secure, available, performant, and compliant, while serving as a key coordination point between vendors, internal infrastructure teams, InfoSec, and business stakeholders.

Mandatory Experience: SaaS-Ticketing system, Atlassian suite, Jira. also have experience managing on-premise applications running on windows or Linux platforms that require patch and update deployment. The most important qualities are independence and a strong willingness to learn.

Job Experience Requirements:

  • 3–7 years of experience supporting the ticketing system and enterprise applications across SaaS and self-managed models.
  • Hands-on experience with application deployments, patching, and maintenance for self-managed systems.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS operating models, vendor support, and SLA management.
  • Experience with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem, request management).
  • Hands-on experience in administering and supporting ticketing systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot across applications, infrastructure, and integration layers.
  • Strong communication skills to work with vendors and cross-functional IT teams.
  • Experience supporting business-critical or regulated applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid environments.
  • Knowledge of IAM, observability, and security controls.

Job Responsibilities:

Self-Managed Application Support

  • Perform application maintenance for self-managed applications, including deployment of application updates, patches, and fixes.
  • Support production and non-production environments (dev, test, staging, prod).
  • Execute deployments following approved change management (CAB) processes.
  • Monitor application health, availability, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve L2/L3 issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Cloud Infrastructure, IAM, and InfoSec teams for changes and remediation.

SaaS (Managed Service) Application Support

  • Act as the primary IT point of contact for SaaS applications managed by external vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support escalations, and SLA adherence.
  • Coordinate SaaS releases, upgrades, and vendor-led changes, including impact assessment and business communications.
  • Validate vendor patching, security updates, and release notes for enterprise impact.
  • Support SaaS configuration changes, user provisioning, role management, and integrations.
  • Partner with InfoSec and Compliance to support risk assessments, audits, and vendor reviews.

Incident, Request & Service Management

  • Provide L2/L3 support for incidents and service requests across SaaS and self-managed applications.
  • Collaborate with GSD / Client Services for L1 support and escalation workflows.
  • Ensure timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and proper ticket documentation.

Security, Compliance & Risk

  • Support application patching and vulnerability remediation (self-managed) and validation (SaaS).
  • Ensure applications align with IAM, data protection, and enterprise security standards.
  • Support audit, SOX, GxP, and compliance activities by providing operational evidence.

Governance, Documentation & Lifecycle Management

  • Maintain application documentation, runbooks, and support models.
  • Participate in application onboarding, upgrades, renewals, and decommissioning.
  • Support application rationalization and standardization initiatives.

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
About IPM  

The Institute of Project Management (IPM) is a fast-growing, global education and certification business serving over 40,000 professionals worldwide. We work with organisations across Europe, the Middle East, and beyond to raise the standard of project management through education, certification, and community. IPM operates at the intersection of education, technology, and professional services - and we’re now entering a performance-driven growth phase. This role will work closely with the founder and leadership team to help scale IPM’s global reach, pipeline, and revenue. 

The Role:  

We’re hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to take ownership of IPM’s marketing execution and turn it into a predictable, performance-driven growth engine. This is not a brand-only or strategy-only role. It is a hands-on leadership role with clear accountability for outcomes. You will be responsible for both doing the work and directing others. If growth stalls, leads drop, or funnels underperform - you own the fix. IPM is not looking for incremental optimisation. We’re looking for someone who can move fast, prioritise hard, and build systems that scale. We see this role growing and becoming a  Head of Growth Marketing  in the future. 

What You'll Own:  

  • Ownership of marketing strategy as it relates to revenue growth, pipeline, and conversion 
  • Hands-on performance marketing across SEO, paid acquisition, funnels, and CRO 
  • Paid channels (Google, Meta, LinkedIn) with clear ROI accountability 
  • SEO prioritisation and execution (with existing SEO resources) 
  • Funnel design, landing pages, and conversion optimisation 
  • Analytics, attribution, dashboards, and weekly reporting 
  • Lead quality, CAC, and pipeline contribution 
  • Lean leadership of the marketing team (hands-on + direction) 

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months):  

  • Marketing is clearly structured, prioritised, and accountable 
  • Lead volume and quality increase materially across core markets 
  • Paid acquisition becomes measurable, scalable, and controlled 
  • SEO performance improves with clear execution focus 
  • Funnels are simplified and conversion rates improve 
  • The marketing team is aligned behind clear goals and metrics 
  • The founder no longer needs to drive or chase marketing execution 

Who This Role is For:  

You are:  

  • A performance-first marketer who thinks in numbers and funnels 
  • Comfortable owning results, not just activity 
  • Confident inheriting a real, imperfect marketing setup and improving it 
  • Data-literate and commercially minded 
  • Comfortable leading people and making hard prioritisation decisions 

You are not looking for:  

  • A brand-custodian role 
  • A slow, consensus-driven environment 
  • A role without real accountability 

Requirements:  

  • Proven experience in growth or performance marketing 
  • Strong background in SEO and paid acquisition 
  • Experience scaling funnels and improving conversion 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
  • Clear communication and ownership mindset 

Nice to have:  

  • B2B, education, or SaaS experience 
  • Multi-market or international experience 

Why Join IPM:  

  • Real ownership and autonomy 
  • Direct access to the founder and leadership team 
  • Global scope and meaningful scale opportunity 
  • Fully remote role 

Next Steps:  

  • We highly encourage you to message our Chief Executive directly on LinkedIn:  
  • Your message should explain why you’re interested and include a success story from a similar role. 
  • You are also encouraged to share anything that supports your application (e.g. a video message, cover letter, or case study). 
  • Please also include your salary expectations or range to help us ensure early alignment and keep the process efficient. 

Please note that as our team is globally remote we use Clickup & Monitask to manage and record our work.

title: Analista Pleno de Operações e Integração
description:
Sobre o Likin.do

O Likin.do é um marketplace brasileiro que conecta consumidores a varejistas locais — com entrega rápida em poucas horas e uma curadoria rigorosa de marcas. Somos uma startup de tecnologia em crescimento, com time enxuto, ritmo acelerado e produto em construção ativa. Ao longo dessa jornada, destacamos as ações positivas de cada parceiro — porque acreditamos que conveniência e consciência podem andar juntos.

O que você vai construir

Você será o elo entre sellers, consumidores e os times internos do Likin.do. Metade do seu tempo é garantir que novos sellers entrem na plataforma sem atrito — do onboarding ao go-live. A outra metade é manter a operação rodando: triando incidentes, coordenando resoluções e estruturando processos que evitam que o mesmo problema apareça duas vezes. Aqui operação é estratégia.

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Onboarding e ativação de sellers (B2B)

  • Receber sellers do time comercial após fechamento e conduzir o onboarding operacional
  • Coletar e organizar dados para integração — via API ou processo manual, dependendo da marca
  • Fazer ponte com o time de desenvolvimento: abrir demandas bem descritas, acompanhar prazos e validar entregas
  • Executar checklist de go-live: cadastros, configurações, testes e operação validada
  • Acompanhar os primeiros dias do seller na plataforma e garantir estabilização

Suporte operacional (B2C e B2B)

  • Receber, registrar e tratar chamados de consumidores e sellers via ferramentas de atendimento
  • Classificar incidentes por severidade e coordenar resolução com Dev, Financeiro e Logística
  • Monitorar reputação e feedbacks: Reclame Aqui, Google Play, App Store
  • Manter comunicação clara com o solicitante durante todo o processo de resolução

Processos e melhoria contínua

  • Documentar e atualizar playbooks e procedimentos operacionais
  • Criar e manter base de conhecimento e FAQ
  • Identificar padrões de problema e propor automações e melhorias
  • Gerar relatórios básicos de performance (SLA, principais motivos de contato, gargalos)

Requisitos obrigatórios — sem esses, não adianta aplicar

  • Mínimo 2 anos de experiência em operações, suporte ou CS em ambiente de marketplace ou e-commerce
  • Experiência com onboarding B2B — implantações, ativações, integrações
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de atendimento (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Salesforce Service ou similar)
  • Organização e escrita clara — tickets, documentação e playbooks fazem parte do dia a dia
  • Capacidade de priorizar múltiplas demandas simultâneas sem perder o fio
  • Experiência com Jira ou metodologia ágil
  • Autonomia real para trabalho remoto — sem microgestão, com entrega e responsabilidade

Diferenciais que contam pontos

  • Noção de integrações via API (sem precisar programar — só entender o fluxo)
  • Experiência com logística e última milha
  • Rotina com métricas de suporte (SLA, CSAT, backlog)
  • Uso ativo de ferramentas de IA para ganhar velocidade no atendimento e documentação
  • Interesse genuíno em produto sustentável e consumo consciente

Como é trabalhar no Likin.do

  • Remoto 100%
  • Contrato PJ
  • Preferência por candidatos de Bento Gonçalves/RS e região
  • Horário comercial — com consciência de que conforme a operação cresce, isso evolui
  • Time pequeno = sua contribuição aparece de verdade
  • Acesso direto à liderança de operações e produto

Remuneração

A partir de R$ 5.000/mês PJ. Se você é aquele perfil fora da curva, senta com a gente e a gente conversa.

title: Especialista de Segurança da Informação I (Cyber Threat Intelligence)
description:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coleção e análise de inteligência: OSINT/HUMINT, monitoramento de deep/dark web, fóruns e marketplaces de threat actors, identificação de leaks (dados, credenciais, cartões, kits de phishing, malwares).
  • Brand e Executive Protection: proteção de marca, domínio e executivos (typosquatting, spoofing, influencer/clone, perfis falsos, phishing kits).
  • Produção de inteligência acionável: elaboração de PIRs (Priority Intelligence Requirements), criação de Collection Plans, relatórios estratégicos/táticos/operacionais, briefings executivos e TL, DR para tomada de decisão.
  • Análise de TTPs: mapeamento em MITRE ATT&CK, ATT&CK Navigator, criação de detections (Sigma/YARA) e hipóteses para Threat Hunting.
  • Purple Teaming: condução de Purple Exercises com Red/Blue, validação contínua de controles (BAS como Cymulate/Similares), hardening de AD (Tiering, LAPS, Kerberos, Delegações, GPOs), uso de Purple Knight/BloodHound para identificar caminhos de ataque.
  • Integração com SOC/CSIRT: criação e tuning de regras no SIEM/SOAR, priorização de alertas, enriquecimento de IOCs/IOAs, suporte a investigações e resposta a incidentes.
  • Gestão de IOCs/MISP/TIPs: curadoria, scoring, deduplicação, enriquecimento e automação de feeds/provedores, governança de taxonomias (ex.: MISP Galaxy/Clusters).
  • Ameaças ao financeiro: acompanhamento de Threat Landscape (fraudes, mule accounts, trojans bancários, ransomware-as-a-service, initial access brokers, engenharia social, QRishing, MFA bypass, SIM swap, Pix/instant payments).
  • Conformidade & risco: apoio a políticas e padrões (NIST/ISO/CIS), evidências para auditorias e reporte a comitês de risco.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou em cursando em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Segurança da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com CTI (estratégico/tático/operacional) com atuação prática em deep/dark web e análise de comunidades de ameaças.
  • Vivência em Purple/Red/Blue realizando participação em pentests/red teaming e/ou BAS, habilidade de traduzir inteligência em controles e deteções.
  • Domínio em MITRE ATT&CK, MISP/TIPs, técnicas de OSINT e HUMINT, criação de YARA/Sigma, noções de malware analysis e forense (memória/endpoint).
  • Experiência com validação de controles de segurança (EDR/XDR, E-mail Gateway, WAF, DLP, ZTNA/Proxy, Cloud, EASM/ASM) e hardening de AD.
  • Conhecimento em Threat Landscape Financeiro.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura/redação.
  • Disponibilidade para participar de exercícios com Red/Blue e on-call pontual durante incidentes críticos.

Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse :

  • Experiência com Cymulate (ou BAS similar), Purple Knight, BloodHound/Sharphound, ATT&CK Navigator.
  • Automação com Python (enriquecimento, parsing de IOCs, integração com APIs de TIP/SIEM/SOAR).
  • Certificações: GCTI, GOSI, GREM, GPEN, OSINT, CFR, eJPT/eCPPT, CARTP/CRTP/CRTE, Azure/M365 Security.

Ferramentas e stack desejadas:

  • TIP/Intel: MISP, OpenCTI/TIPs comerciais, VirusTotal/Hybrid, Shodan/Censys, Maltego.
  • Detecção/Resposta: SIEM (Splunk/QRadar/Elastic), SOAR, EDR/XDR (Defender, Vision One, CarbonBlack, CrowdStrike, etc.).
  • Purple/BAS & AD: Cymulate/AttackIQ, Purple Knight, BloodHound.
  • Hunting/Detections: Sigma, YARA, KQL/ESQL, Zeek/Suricata; ATT&CK Navigator.
  • Brand/Dark: plataformas de brand monitoring, dark web monitoring e takedown.

Indicadores desejáveis:

  • TTI (Time-to-Intel) e Actionability dos reports; taxa de PIRs atendidos.
  • Cobertura de TTPs (ATT&CK) e detections derivadas de inteligência.
  • Redução de janela de exposição (tempo de takedown/containment) e de falsos positivos.
  • Validação contínua de controles (BAS) e fechamento de gaps críticos (AD/endpoint/email/web).

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. Foundey is looking for a talented Marketer to join our dynamic Design agency. We are in search of someone with a passion for crafting compelling and user-centric content specifically for social media platforms, with a primary focus on LinkedIn.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of how to engage and grow an online audience through strategic content creation. This is a unique opportunity to be part of an early-stage start-up and to be part of its growth.

You will have the exciting responsibility of crafting and optimizing content for our social media platforms from the ground up. If you thrive on creating engaging content and possess a genuine passion and extensive expertise in social media writing and design, this role is perfect for you.

Join our team and play a vital role in shaping our marketing strategy and driving the rapid growth of our business.

At Foundey, we help companies transform their digital experiences through design and technology. We’re looking for a Content & Brand Marketer — someone who can create impactful content while shaping and strengthening our brand presence.

What you will do

  • Develop and execute content strategies to attract, engage, and convert our target audience.
  • Create high-quality content for blog posts, social media, newsletters, and case studies, always aligned with our brand voice.
  • Collaborate with design and sales teams to ensure consistent messaging and positioning across all touchpoints.
  • Manage and grow Foundey’s digital presence, ensuring our brand is recognizable and differentiated.
  • Plan and optimize campaigns for lead generation and brand awareness.
  • Build key messages and narratives to strengthen the positioning of the brand and its products, ensuring consistency of tone of voice, storytelling and positioning across all points of contact.
  • Track content and campaign performance, using insights to improve strategy and execution.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends and content marketing best practices.
  • Measure and report results.
  • Monitor and analyze social media metrics to refine content strategy and improve performance.

What we are looking for

  • Experience with content creation and brand marketing, ideally within tech companies or startups.
  • Strong writing skills with an eye for storytelling, tone of voice, and brand consistency.
  • Strategic mindset, able to think about how content supports broader brand goals.
  • Familiarity with inbound marketing, SEO, and social media strategy.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with design, product, and sales teams.
  • Organized and proactive, able to manage multiple initiatives at once.
  • Experience with SaaS or digital products.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of UX, UI, or design thinking principles.
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, or similar platforms.

Qualifications

  • Professional English
  • Proven experience as a UX Writer, Content Designer, or similar role focused on social media.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing your work in social media content creation and design.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills.
  • Experience with LinkedIn content creation and management.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of user-centered design principles and practices.
  • Familiarity with social media analytics tools and metrics.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with SEO and content optimization for social media.
  • Knowledge of design tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar.
  • Background in marketing, journalism, or a related field.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, startup environment.

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Infrastructure, Network & Security Analyst
description:
Job Title: Infrastructure, Network and Security Analyst

Job level: Pl/ Sr Analyst

Department: IT

Reports To: Senior Manager of IT, LATAM

Location: Indaiatuba City, São Paulo, Brazil

SVP Worldwide is the world’s largest consumer sewing machine company, proudly home to the iconic brands SINGER® , HUSQVARNA® VIKING® , PFAFF® , and CREATIVATE™ . Together, our brands represent nearly 500 years of combined leadership , empowering sewists around the world and shaping the evolution of sewing for generations.

Our purpose is clear: to create, elevate, and celebrate sewists around the world .

With global operations spanning R&D, manufacturing, distribution, and sales, SVP Worldwide brings together heritage craftsmanship and modern innovation to serve a worldwide community of makers.

Our expanding portfolio includes sewing and embroidery machines, accessories and notions, garment care, and creative software — offering meaningful opportunities to innovate, collaborate, and make an impact.

Guided by our values — customer-first thinking, curiosity and creativity, inclusion, and transparency — we’re building a connected, inclusive culture where people can grow their careers while helping define the future of sewing.

Position Summary

The Infrastructure, Network and Security Analyst will support and sustain IT infrastructure across Latin America, ensuring secure, resilient technology environments aligned with regional and global organizational strategies.

This professional will play a key role in supporting business operations and initiatives while contributing to data governance, cybersecurity, and operational efficiency. We are seeking a technical, strategic, and proactive professional with strong analytical skills and the ability to operate effectively in complex, multicultural environments.

Responsibilities

  • Administer and oversee on-premises and cloud IT environments (IaaS and PaaS), including data centers, LAN/SD-WAN networks, servers, storage, and backup systems, ensuring high availability and compliance with global standards.
  • Implement and monitor information security policies, including data protection, access control, encryption, and vulnerability management, ensuring adherence to regulations such as LGPD and ISO 27001.
  • Support IT service management with a focus on resilience and business continuity, interfacing with vendors, monitoring SLAs, and assisting with governance and budget control (CAPEX/OPEX).
  • Provide advanced technical support in resolving critical incidents, serving as a key liaison between technology and business teams.
  • Maintain and optimize critical corporate applications, including SAP ERP, non-SAP systems, and other essential operational platforms.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives related to cloud computing, cybersecurity, automation (RPA), artificial intelligence, and data analytics.
  • Monitor infrastructure and security performance metrics, recommending continuous improvements.
  • Document processes, architectures, and best practices to strengthen IT governance.

Requirements and preferred experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Networks, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in infrastructure administration, networking, and information security.
  • Experience with hybrid environments and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Background managing critical environments and supporting high-availability operations.
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and standards.
  • Certifications such as CCNA, ITIL, CompTIA Security+, Microsoft, AWS, or similar.
  • Experience with SAP and corporate system integrations.

Languages:

  • Advanced English (mandatory) — ability to operate in a global corporate environment.
  • Intermediate Spanish — to support Latin American operations.

Skills, Abilities and knowledge:

  • Strategic mindset with strong execution capability.
  • Excellent analytical and complex problem-solving skills.
  • High sense of accountability, particularly within security-critical environments.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize in dynamic settings.
  • Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborative profile with experience working across multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
  • Proactive, resilient, and oriented toward continuous improvement.
  • Strong commitment to quality, operational stability, and technological advancement.

We offer you:

  • Benefits: medical and life insurance, food basket (or card), canteen at the factory
  • Profit Sharing Program
  • Hybrid work schedule
  • Work environment that harbors a culture of collaboration and community
  • Learning and development opportunities

Work Environment / Location / Flexibility

SVP Worldwide offers a fast-paced and ever-evolving environment. As part of our Flexible Workplace Policy, this position follows a hybrid work model 3 days per week on-site at our headquarters in Indaiatuba, São Paulo .

Why You Will Love Being Part of SVP Worldwide

We take care of our team! We offer a competitive benefits package, including multiple healthcare plan options, on-site meals, grocery allowance or meal vouchers, pharmacy benefits, profit sharing, life insurance, and educational partnerships.

At SVP Worldwide, we celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion and strive to build a workforce reflective of our global consumers. This means understanding, respecting, and valuing diverse styles, experiences, identities, ideas, and opinions while being inclusive of all people.

SVP Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, nationality, citizenship, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status.

In the News

In 2021, SVP Worldwide was acquired by Platinum Equity , a global investment firm with more than $25 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of approximately 50 operating companies serving customers worldwide. Platinum Equity is fully committed to supporting SVP Worldwide’s continued growth by providing additional financial and operational resources to accelerate the company’s efforts.

title: IT Consultant - CyberSecurity
description:
Korn Ferry has partnered with our client on their search for IT Consultant - CyberSecurity

Purpose of the Position

To strengthen the Information Security capability of a large corporate and investment banking institution at a critical moment of regulatory, infrastructure and systems transformation , ensuring that security is effectively embedded into the expansion and modernization of on-premise environments .

The bank is executing a complex set of initiatives driven by regulatory requirements related to corporate identification (CNPJ) , which require significant adaptations across multiple systems, including large-scale legacy COBOL platforms and the duplication and expansion of development and UAT environments .

This position exists to act as a hands-on security reference within the Information Security team , providing the technical depth, execution capacity and security judgment required to navigate this transformation safely. While the overall program is infrastructure-led , its success depends on ensuring that security controls are consistently applied, validated and sustained throughout implementation and beyond.

The role bridges the gap between project execution and day-to-day security operations (BAU) , ensuring that new servers, systems, integrations and access models are deployed in line with the bank’s security standards, regulatory expectations and risk appetite . This includes validating hardening standards, EDR and antivirus policies, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, IAM and access governance , as well as supporting secure development practices in coordination with development teams and existing security tooling (e.g., Veracode ).

Beyond the implementation phase, this position is critical to ensuring continuity and stability once third-party vendors disengage. The individual will retain technical ownership and operational responsibility for the security posture of the new environments, becoming a trusted internal point of reference capable of responding quickly to incidents, vulnerabilities and emerging risks.

The Candidate

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Act as the security focal point during a large-scale on-premise infrastructure duplication and modernization project , driven by Central Bank regulatory requirements .
  • Support the duplication and expansion of UAT and development environments , ensuring security controls are correctly implemented across servers, antivirus, EDR, password vaults, vulnerability scanners, IAM and access governance .
  • Operate in a highly complex legacy environment , including COBOL-based ecosystems deeply integrated with multiple critical systems.
  • Balance project-related security demands with Business As Usual (BAU) activities, including vulnerability management, incident response and tool optimization .
  • Review and validate large volumes of technical documentation produced by infrastructure, data, IAM and third-party vendors.
  • Ensure that security requirements are not overlooked during fast-paced infrastructure changes, despite not owning project timelines or acting as project manager.
  • Take over operational security support once third-party vendors disengage.
  • Manage security implications of increased scale, including server growth, expanded IPS / vulnerability scanning ranges, and increased IAM and SoD complexity .
  • Act decisively in situations of technical ambiguity , prioritizing rapid risk reduction over waiting for perfect information.
  • Handle urgent requests and stakeholder pressure while maintaining a firm, technically sound security stance.
  • Act as a technical executor , not only a strategist, capable of “getting hands dirty” while applying best practices in daily operations.
  • Navigate a multicultural environment , with frequent interactions and meetings in English with global teams.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Proven background in information security project implementation , particularly in on-premise data centers and legacy system modernization .
  • Solid knowledge of vulnerability management (infrastructure and application layers) and DAST / SAST concepts (e.g., DAST, Veracode, vulnerability scanning interpretation ).
  • Experience validating and enforcing hardening standards , antivirus / EDR policies , and password vaults and secrets management .
  • Understanding of secure development pipelines and DevSecOps concepts (hands-on DevSecOps experience is a strong plus, not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with IAM, access governance, SoD , and security impacts on databases, networks, operating systems and middleware .
  • Experience working alongside and technically guiding third-party vendors (IAM, Infrastructure, Data, Security).
  • Ability to execute hands-on security tasks when needed, while effectively leveraging vendors when available.
  • Comfortable operating in environments with COBOL / legacy platforms and large-scale, business-critical systems .
  • Experience in regulated financial environments or highly governed industries is highly desirable.
  • Advanced conversational English to absorb global directives and participate in international meetings.
  • Knowledge of banking processes, regulations and compliance requirements is a strong differential.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Technology or related fields .

Behavioral Skills

  • Technical Leadership & Influence – Demonstrates strong technical leadership without formal authority, influencing infrastructure, development and vendor teams across complex environments.
  • Proactive Execution & Speed – Acts decisively in the face of ambiguity and incomplete information, prioritizing rapid risk reduction and hands-on execution over excessive process.
  • Problem Solving & Resilience – Thrives in high-pressure environments, including incident response and firefighting, focusing on root-cause resolution rather than temporary fixes.
  • Ownership, Trust & Collaboration – Shows strong accountability and prioritization, becoming a trusted security advisor while collaborating effectively across security, infrastructure, development and data teams.

title: Portuguese-speaking (Senior) Manager Corporate M&A/ Corporate Development

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

title: Information Security Specialist
description:
At Iris, we don’t just build companies; we forge the leaders of the technological frontier. Our mission is to redefine the future through Cloud, Data, AI, and Cybersecurity. Through Ciberia, our dedicated cybersecurity arm and Google Premier Partner for EMEA & LATAM, we are setting a new global standard for digital protection.

We are looking for a professional who thrives where intelligent security meets professional intuition, helping us transform international projects into resilient digital fortresses.

Your Mission

As our Information Security Specialist, you will serve as the vital bridge between global strategy and regional execution. You will be the face of Information Security locally, ensuring that our corporate standards are seamlessly integrated into both corporate (IT) and industrial (OT) environments. Your goal is to foster a culture of security maturity while acting as the primary point of contact for regional operations.

Your main tasks and accountabilities will be

  • Strategic Alignment: Translate corporate security policies and standards into local actionable controls, ensuring 100% compliance across regional operations.
  • Industrial Resilience (OT): Partner with plant managers and automation teams to secure industrial environments, focusing on the unique challenges of manufacturing and production uptime.
  • Governance & Compliance: Lead the charge in obtaining and maintaining critical certifications such as ISO 27001, TISAX, and IATF 16949.
  • Architecture & Risk: Conduct security architecture reviews for IT projects and lead risk assessments to proactively mitigate threats before they impact the business.
  • Incident Orchestration: Serve as the first regional escalation point for security incidents, managing the lifecycle of a breach from detection to reporting.
  • Culture & Metrics: Drive security awareness locally and deliver high-impact KPIs and reporting to HQ to track our regional security posture.

What do we expect from you?

Technical Expertise:

  • Deep understanding of the intersection between IT and OT (network segmentation, industrial firewalls, DMZ, and Zero Trust).
  • Hands-on experience with the Microsoft Defender Suite, Splunk, or Palo Alto.
  • Mastery of RBAC and Identity Management frameworks.
  • Familiarity with audit methodologies and reporting via Power BI, ServiceNow, or Jira.

Experience & Education:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Industrial Electronics, or similar.
  • Experience: 3–5 years in Information Security, with at least 1–2 years specifically in industrial or hybrid IT/OT environments.
  • Certifications (Highly Valued): CISSP, CISM, CISA, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor.
  • Languages: Fluency in English (B2-C1); Spanish is a strong "nice to have."

Soft Skills & Core Values:

We are looking for an analytical thinker who doesn’t just identify problems but solves them with a pratice-oriented mindset. You should be an autonomous professional who can communicate complex technical risks to business stakeholders with clarity and integrity.

  • Orientado(a) a dados: mede, prioriza e executa plano de ação
  • Alta cadência e follow-up: confortável em operar volume no dia a dia
  • Mão na massa: escreve mensagens, monta campanhas, negocia e fecha

Requisitos

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com afiliados / influenciadores com cupom/link (ou parcerias focadas em venda)
  • Organização forte (CRM/planilhas), gestão de carteira e rotina de follow-up
  • Noções sólidas de e-commerce (conversão, ticket médio, devoluções, margem)

Diferenciais

  • Noções de tracking (UTM, atribuição) e leitura de métricas
  • Experiência com CRM (ex.: Klaviyo) e campanhas de ciclo de vida
  • Experiência criando tiers, rankings e incentivos por performance

KPIs do cargo

title: Partnerships Manager LATAM
description:
About DigiFist

DigiFist builds growth-focused products in the Shopify ecosystem. We’re preparing the launch of a new Shopify App in the conversational commerce / messaging category. Our go-to-market is partner-first : we scale through agencies who serve Shopify merchants.

The role

We’re hiring a Partnerships Manager (LATAM) to build our agency partner channel from zero to scale , starting with Brazil and expanding into Spanish LATAM .

Your mission: recruit, activate, and grow a network of agencies that consistently bring paying Shopify merchants .

What you’ll do

  • Build a repeatable partner pipeline (prospecting, outreach, communities, events, referrals).
  • Run short, outcome-led demos (10–15 min) focused on merchant results.
  • Close partner agreements and drive clear next steps.
  • Onboard and enable partners with a simple kit (pitch, objection handling, onboarding checklist, implementation flow).
  • Launch co-marketing with partners (webinars, joint content, partner pages, case studies).
  • Track performance and run a monthly rhythm (pipeline reviews + activation reviews).
  • Send structured feedback to founder/product: objections, friction points, market insights.

Who we’re looking for (must-haves)

  • 3+ years in partnerships / channel sales / agency sales (B2B).
  • Strong network in Brazil’s agency ecosystem (and ability to open doors).
  • Can own the full cycle: prospecting → closing → partner success .
  • Strong e-commerce mindset; Shopify familiarity is a big plus.
  • Portuguese (Brazil) required , English required .
  • Spanish is a strong advantage (to expand into Spanish LATAM).

Nice-to-haves

  • Built or scaled partner/affiliate/reseller programs.
  • Experience selling marketing / CRM / messaging tools to agencies.
  • SaaS GTM experience in LATAM.

What we offer

  • High ownership: you build LATAM from day 1 and shape the playbook.
  • Direct work with founder + product (fast decisions, fast iteration).
  • Competitive base + performance variable tied to measurable outcomes.

KPI examples (we track these)

  1. qualified agency partner leads (monthly)
  2. signed partners (monthly)
  3. active partners (activated in last 30 days)
  4. partner-sourced paying merchants (monthly)
  5. Partner-sourced MRR (net)
  6. Demo → partner close rate (and/or partner → merchant activation rate)

What success looks like in the first 90 days

  • Clear partner ICP + repeatable outbound engine + tracking system.
  • First signed partners + standardized onboarding kit (v1).
  • First co-marketing activity live (webinar or joint content).
  • LATAM objection-handling doc + positioning insights.
  • A pipeline at 3–4x target coverage .

Apply

Send a short message including:

  • The types of agencies you’ve worked with (Brazil/LATAM)
  • 2–3 concrete partnership results
  • Your strongest channel (outbound, community, events, etc.)

description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa para atuar com Arquitetura de TI para liderar a definição e implementação de arquiteturas tecnológicas que sustentem a estratégia da empresa. Este profissional terá papel tático e estratégico, garantindo que as decisões técnicas estejam alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio, promovendo inovação, escalabilidade, segurança e governança.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais entregas:

  • Modelos de referência e diretrizes arquiteturais para desenvolvimento e infraestrutura;
  • Arquitetura documentada, alinhada às estratégias da empresa;
  • Roadmap de evolução tecnológica e inovação dos sistemas;
  • Estrutura de governança técnica para garantir conformidade e boas práticas;
  • Planos de modernização e migração de sistemas legados para cloud;
  • Estratégias de integração e interoperabilidade entre plataformas;
  • Relatórios e recomendações sobre novas tecnologias e tendências.

No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Garantir que visões de referência, patterns, ADRs e estratégias arquiteturais estejam sendo seguidas, avaliando seu nível de aderência;
  • Comunicar ideias complexas de forma clara, promovendo colaboração entre áreas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Documentar as soluções e manter esse processo incorporado à rotina das tribos;
  • Influenciar a direção técnica, promovendo a escalabilidade, qualidade e resiliência das soluções;
  • Trabalhar junto às tribos para garantir entregas aderentes à arquitetura e às melhores práticas de engenharia de software.

Requisitos e qualificações

Hard Skills :

  • Experiência como arquiteto de software ou liderança técnica em times de engenharia;
  • Sólido conhecimento em linguagens de programação (Java, Python, Go, etc.) e frameworks como Spring Boot ou Quarkus;
  • Domínio de design patterns, princípios SOLID, Clean Code e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Vivência com diferentes estilos arquiteturais (Monolito, SOA, Microservices, Event-Driven, etc.);
  • Experiência com arquiteturas baseadas em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP), microsserviços, APIs e integrações;
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL e NoSQL);
  • Familiaridade com protocolos de integração como RESTful, gRPC, GraphQL e WebSocket;
  • Domínio em arquitetura de software (Hexagonal, Onion, Clean Architecture, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia, WAF, etc.);
  • Experiência com computação distribuída, infraestrutura, redes e orquestração de containers (Kubernetes, EKS);
  • Vivência com práticas DevSecOps e automação;
  • Conhecimentos em observabilidade (SLA, SLI, SLO, DORA Metrics, SRE) e qualidade de software (TDD, BDD, testes unitários/integrados).

Soft Skills:

  • Proatividade e autonomia para antecipar desafios e propor soluções eficazes;
  • Clareza de comunicação com diferentes públicos (técnico e não técnico);
  • Colaboração e influência para decisões estratégicas em equipe;
  • Pensamento crítico e foco em melhoria contínua;
  • Visão sistêmica com responsabilidade sobre o impacto técnico e de negócio;
  • Capacidade de mentoria técnica e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Adaptabilidade a contextos e demandas em constante mudança.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud);
  • Experiência com plataformas de observabilidade (Datadog, Dynatrace, Grafana, etc.);
  • Experiência prévia como desenvolvedor(a), tech lead ou engenheiro(a) de software.

title: COORDENADOR DE MANUTENÇÃO REGIONAL
description:
Garantir suporte técnico, padronização, governança e melhoria contínua dos processos de manutenção das unidades operacionais da região, assegurando aderência aos padrões HARSCO aumentando a disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos.

DESAFIOS DO CARGO

Elevar a maturidade dos processos de manutenção dos sites.

Garantir aplicação consistente dos planos de manutenção corporativos.

Aumentar confiabilidade dos ativos por meio de análise técnica e disciplina operacional.

Atuar como elo técnico entre operação, engenharia, suprimentos e fornecedores.

Suportar decisões de CAPEX, especificações técnicas, RFQ e estratégias de reforma.

Desenvolver tecnicamente supervisores e planejadores dos sites.

ATIVIDADES

1. Suporte Técnico Regional

  • Atuar como ponto focal para suporte técnico aos supervisores e gerentes de manutenção dos sites.
  • Revisar e orientar diagnósticos de falhas críticas (RCFA / 5 Porquês / Ishikawa).
  • Apoiar decisões de “retirar ou manter máquina”, garantindo segurança e confiabilidade

2. Governança e Padronização:

  • Garantir que todos os sites executem o plano de manutenção corporativo revisado.
  • Validar cumprimento de preventivas, preditivas das unidades.
  • Aplicar auditorias técnicas periódicas de manutenção.
  • Acompanhar indicadores regionais: Disponibilidade, Confiabilidade, MTBF, MTTR, backlog, Service Accuracy, Aderência Programação etc.

3. Suporte ao Planejamento & PCM dos Sites

  • Orientar o PCM dos sites quanto à priorização de backlog, sequência PM, peças críticas e otimização de estoques.
  • Monitorar performance das execuções PM e corretivas.

4. Especificações, Engenharia de Manutenção e CAPEX

  • Participar tecnicamente de RFQs de equipamentos.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de escopo para CAPEX e reformas estruturais.
  • Avaliar tecnicamente equipamentos usados para aquisição.
  • Liderar as grandes reformas de máquinas móveis pesadas.

5. Relação com Fornecedores & Qualidade Técnica

  • Avaliar e homologar fornecedores regionais de manutenção, reforma e peças.
  • Cobrar performance técnica de fornecedores (qualidade de reparo, garantia, lead time).
  • Realizar visitas técnicas para inspeção e auditoria em oficinas externas

6. Relatórios e Gestão de Resultados Regionais

  • Consolidar, analisar e reportar indicadores técnicos regionais ao gerente regional.
  • Gerar relatórios de conformidade, ações corretivas, riscos e recomendações executivas.
  • Contribuir para fóruns de governança de ativos e comitês regionais de manutenção.

7. Outras Atividades de Suporte

  • Apoiar comissionamento de novos equipamentos.
  • Avaliar e sugerir melhorias na infraestrutura de oficinas dos sites.
  • Participar de investigações de incidentes envolvendo equipamentos.

CONHECIMENTOS GERAIS

Formação Mínima:

Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Produção, Mecatrônica ou Elétrica

Formação Ideal

Superior completo em Engenharia com especialização em engenharia de manutenção ou confiabilidade.

Experiência

3–5 anos em manutenção de equipamentos móveis pesados (carregadeiras, caminhões fora de estrada, escavadeiras, MH).

Experiência prévia como supervisor de engenharia/PCM ou engenheiro de manutenção.

title: Technical Product Manager - Live Streaming Platforms
description:
Role: Technical Product Manager – Live Streaming Platforms

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Contract

Responsibilities

  • Act as Product Owner for a scrum team dedicated to the Media Customer + Live Services

Platform

  • Collaborate with the Live Streaming Operations & Engineering teams to build knowledge

of existing live streaming-related systems and gain an understanding of needs from the

larger team in order to translate those needs into actionable projects and long-term

roadmap

prioritization)

documentation, use cases, workflows, sequence diagrams, UML diagrams, etc.

  • Work across domains and external teams to ensure all requirements are gathered and

documented in JIRA.

  • Align various stakeholders across product, technology & operations on delivery scope

and in preparation for launches

partners

  • Develop trust across teams and build relationships to ensure collaboration across

groups; facilitate execution within a complex organizational environment

  • Create a strong partnership with both Live Streaming Operations & Engineering; work

together to determine solutions and ensure that the development team has all the

information they need to successfully execute initiatives

  • Additional other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

  • 3-5years of experience in product management for software development, with

demonstrated competence in prioritizing against business value and balancing

trade-offs

  • Demonstrated passion for building workflow tools and supporting internal teams
  • Deep understanding of &comfort with complex technical workflow systems and tools,

including video-related workflows- with bonus points for experience with Live systems.

  • Ability to define, prioritize and execute on a Live Streaming product backlog across

multiple systems and stakeholders

  • Strong interest in and understanding of the streaming media landscape
  • Able to form valuable relationships with people across functional groups in order to

facilitate effective product development

  • Strong sense of best practices for product management and have extensive experience

with Agile development methodologies

  • Excellent communication skills, ability to lead meetings and drive result

Apoiar a implementação de controles como MFA, RBAC e boas práticas OWASP, orientando tecnicamente as equipes de desenvolvimento.

Levantar e documentar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais de segurança, formalizando-os para backlog e Definition of Done.

Capacidade de atuar como ponto de contato entre segurança e desenvolvimento, garantindo remediação efetiva e segurança integrada ao processo.

Direcionar e acompanhar o status das vulnerabilidades em aberto até remediação completa, utilizando ferramentas de tracking e dashboards.

title: Procurement Leader
description:

Fluency in English is mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a key member of the Brazilian procurement team, reporting directly to the Procurement Manager and leading a team of three professionals, ensuring high performance, clear priorities, and continuous professional development.
  • Support the Procurement Manager by taking ownership of operational procurement activities, KPI tracking, and local negotiations, allowing greater focus on strategic initiatives.

  • Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain, preferably within ink manufacturing, chemicals, or industrial environments.
  • Proven experience in a leadership or senior role, including team coordination or people management.
  • Strong negotiation skills and solid knowledge of procurement processes, supplier management, and contract governance.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities, including spend analysis and cost modeling.
  • High proficiency in Excel (including VBA and database management), with a strong data‑driven mindset.
  • Experience with ERP systems; SAP experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in cross‑functional and international environments.
  • Fluent English is mandatory for interaction with global teams and international suppliers.

title: Analista Sênior de Performance (Mídia + Dados)
description:
Sobre a Not Agency

A Not Agency é uma consultoria de inteligência digital, mídia e ciência de dados que atua junto a alguns dos maiores players do mercado nacional. Combinamos profundidade analítica, execução técnica de excelência e visão estratégica para transformar dados em resultados reais.

Valorizamos profissionais com base sólida em áreas exatas, curiosidade intelectual e atenção a detalhes — que desejam crescer em um ambiente remoto, colaborativo e de alta performance, propício ao desenvolvimento contínuo e à construção de carreira.

Missão da posição

Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica em mídia de performance, liderando a estratégia e a operação de canais pagos (Meta, Google e demais aplicáveis) para e-commerce e negócios digitais. A posição é responsável por garantir qualidade analítica, consistência de mensuração e decisões orientadas a indicadores reais de negócio (receita, margem, CAC, LTV, recorrência e eficiência incremental), além de estruturar rotinas, padrões de análise e documentação de aprendizados junto ao time e aos clientes.

Principais responsabilidades

Estratégia e gestão de investimento

  • Definir, junto à liderança e ao cliente, a estratégia de performance por canal e etapa de funil (aquisição, ativação, retenção), com metas claras, premissas explícitas e critérios de sucesso.
  • Conduzir planejamento financeiro, pacing e alocação de verba, com projeções, cenários e recomendações de realocação baseadas em dados.
  • Garantir governança avançada de contas: estrutura de campanhas, segmentações, públicos, keywords/negativas, criativos e ofertas, com foco em eficiência, escala e sustentabilidade de resultados.

Análise, otimização e experimentação

  • Monitorar continuamente indicadores-chave (impressões, cliques, CTR, CPC, CPA, receita, ROAS, entre outros), identificando desvios relevantes, causas-raiz e ações prioritárias.
  • Liderar rotinas estruturadas de experimentação (testes A/B, testes controlados ou quase-experimentais), com hipóteses claras, critérios de sucesso definidos, análise crítica e documentação de aprendizados.
  • Produzir análises aprofundadas e orientadas à decisão: variações de mix, saturação, impacto criativo, mudanças de comportamento, performance por público, região, dispositivo e etapa de funil.
  • Mensuração e qualidade de dados (em parceria com Analytics/Engenharia)
  • Assegurar a integridade mínima de tracking para tomada de decisão: eventos, conversões, UTMs, parametrizações e consistência entre plataformas.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de dados no diagnóstico e correção de gaps de mensuração (GA4, GTM, APIs/conversões, deduplicação e regras operacionais de atribuição).
  • Garantir que relatórios e dashboards representem a realidade do negócio — indo além das métricas nativas das plataformas.

Relacionamento com cliente e comunicação executiva

  • Apresentar resultados, análises e recomendações com clareza, objetividade e embasamento técnico, explicitando riscos, trade-offs e planos de ação.
  • Conduzir reuniões semanais e mensais com foco em decisão, priorização e evolução contínua da estratégia.
  • Preparar materiais executivos quando necessário, com narrativa consistente, dados confiáveis e conclusões acionáveis.

Coordenação e padronização

  • Coordenar a rotina operacional e analítica, orientando analistas e/ou parceiros internos e externos quando aplicável.
  • Definir e manter padrões de trabalho: checklists de saúde de contas, frameworks analíticos, templates de fechamento mensal, documentação de testes e playbooks.
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da maturidade técnica e analítica do time de mídia.

Requisitos essenciais

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em mídia de performance, com atuação avançada em pelo menos dois grandes ecossistemas (ex.: Google e Meta).
  • Vivência sólida com e-commerce e indicadores de negócio (receita, margem, CAC, LTV, recorrência), conectando decisões de mídia a impacto financeiro real.
  • Domínio de rotinas de otimização e governança de contas (campanhas, públicos/segmentações, keywords/negativas, criativos e ofertas).
  • Conhecimento sólido de GA4 e familiaridade prática com Google Tag Manager (leitura, validação e diagnóstico de tracking).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado (organização, análise, tabelas dinâmicas, funções e manipulação de dados).
  • Comunicação escrita e verbal consistente, organização, autonomia e responsabilidade para trabalho remoto.

Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência com BigQuery e/ou SQL para análises exploratórias e validação de dados.
  • Experiência com Looker / Looker Studio ou ferramentas similares de BI.
  • Vivência com metodologias de experimentação, incrementalidade e avaliação de impacto além do ROAS de plataforma.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação e materiais técnicos.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
*Your CV must be submitted in English in order to be considered*

Investing.com is seeking a senior, versatile financial marketing professional to grow our Brazilian operations. This role combines financial content and multimedia strategy, marketing leadership, business partnerships, and operational oversight. The ideal candidate will have a strong financial background, as well as proven experience in content creation (including news coverage) and marketing.

You will also serve as a backup for website operations, ensuring continuity in the event of team absences.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop and execute content and marketing strategies tailored to the Brazilian financial market.
  • Create and adapt high-quality financial content for articles, social media, videos, and website copy.
  • Lead multimedia initiatives, including video, audio, and live webinars.
  • Source, negotiate, and manage partnerships with creators, publishers, and financial communities in Brazil.
  • Plan, monitor, and analyze campaigns and content performance to identify trends and growth opportunities.
  • Support website operations and ensure smooth continuity during team absences.
  • Collaborate with global and local teams to align marketing initiatives with business objectives.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years of proven success in financial content marketing, multimedia, or marketing leadership roles
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian financial markets, products, and trends
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Brazilian Portuguese; professional proficiency in English
  • Proven experience in business partnerships, promotional strategies, and driving audience growth
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and project management skills. Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and drive team-oriented outcomes
  • An analytical mindset with the ability to make data-driven decisions

Nice to Have:

  • Existing network of Brazilian finance creators, media, or influencers.
  • On-camera or webinar hosting experience.
  • Familiarity with InvestingPro or similar fintech/SaaS platforms
  • Relevant Brazilian financial certification or license (e.g., CVM-registered or ANCORD certification)

Who We Are:

Investing.com was founded in 2007 and now has over 250 employees worldwide. With 60 million monthly unique visitors, 4 billion page views, over 500 million sessions, and over 300,000 financial instruments covered, Investing.com is one of the top two global financial websites.

Investing.com offers unlimited access to cutting-edge financial markets tools such as real-time quotes and charts, customized portfolios, personal live alerts, calendars, calculators, and financial insights, completely free of charge. In addition to the global stock markets, Investing.com also covers world indices, ETFs, commodities, bonds & Interest Rates, Futures and Options.

Investing.com strives to be a one-stop-shop for traders and investors with apps and a Pro tool available.

What We Offer:

  • Flexibility of remote work
  • An opportunity to join a leading global financial platform and shape its Brazilian presence.
  • Challenging assignments in a fast-paced, international environment.
  • The ability to have a direct impact on the growth of Investing.com in Brazil

Our Privacy Policy: Your resume and information will be kept confidential

BASIC PURPOSE: Audits and tests enterprise applications with a focus on backend ETL (Extract Transformation & Load) processes and other software modules as it pertains to the creation of data warehouse reporting instruments in order to ensure high quality and integrity of the information. Execute based on data and beat “seat of the pants” traditional strategies.

You and the current Specialist will follow our framework, while proactively collaborating with our SEO and client success teams to ensure campaigns are always in-line with overall business goals.

Build campaigns in Google Ads Manager and Ads Editor following our templates and SOPs.

Perform weekly and monthly optimization routines (negative keywords, search term reviews, budgets, ad assets, keyword additions, bidding strategy, etc. ). 

Run through QA checklist before launching or editing a campaign (geo settings, match types, naming conventions, conversion actions, etc. ). 

Maintain documentation and task updates in ClickUp. 

Implement and QA tracking with WhatConverts following established processes.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Manage Local Service Ads (budget pacing, category, verification checks, etc. ). 

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Identify areas of improvement to our SOPs based on test results or recurring events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed 

Minimum of 2 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation (non-ecommerce).

Track record of precision execution and zero critical errors in recent work.

Great analytical skillset for search term review, budget pacing, and campaign adjustments.

Familiar with Google Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, ClickUp, and Slack.

Focus on detail, with ability to follow SOPs 100% and identify opportunities for SOP refinement.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Bonus Experience (not required): 

Experience with Local Service Ads management 

Unbounce 

Experience optimizing paid campaigns for service-based lead generation

Experience with WhatConverts or CallRail 

What We Value  

Data-Driven Execution – Campaigns are backed by analytics, SOPs, and real-time data.

Ownership & Accountability – We don’t micromanage. We hire A-players who take pride in precision and results.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics 

Zero critical errors found in QA across all campaigns.

100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.

Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan. 

Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.

Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule 

Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and skill level.

Schedule: Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process 

We’re serious about hiring because we’re serious about building a team of disciplined executors who thrive in a high-performance culture.

The hiring process:  

Application and screening questions. 

Paid trial project with strict QA rubric. 

Final interview and debrief with the manager and CEO.

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Analytics Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship

We’re looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what’s hot, what’s not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.

● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.

● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

● Deliver strategic insights: Transform your observations into sharp reports and presentations that can actually shape how we grow worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who is:

● A data-savvy observer: Naturally curious about the “why” behind behaviors. You spot patterns in everyday life and can structure your findings clearly.

● A user-obsessed explorer: Always noticing how friends use apps—what works, what frustrates them, what they wish existed.

● A structured thinker: Able to take messy, real-world info and turn it into logical, compelling insights—not just data, but stories that drive decisions.

Bonus if you have:

● Academic or project experience in economics, statistics, computer science, market research, psychology, or related fields.

● Lived overseas and have a genuine interest in regional youth culture and behavior (e.g., North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America).

● Led or contributed to user research, market analysis, or business case studies—and know how to systemize what you learn.

What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth with Meitu Team

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu products membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)

About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards "beauty" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to "Uniting Art and Technology", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.

Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Gerente comercial
description:
MISSÃO DO CARGO :

Garantir o crescimento sustentável da clínica, através da gestão estratégica do funil comercial, da liderança de equipe, da fidelização de pacientes e do desenvolvimento de parcerias externas , assegurando que cada experiência de atendimento reflita o padrão de excelência da Elite Clinic.

A gerente comercial deve unir visão analítica, empatia e foco em resultados , conduzindo o time e as ações comerciais com propósito e alta performance.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS: 1. Gestão Comercial
  • Gerir o funil de vendas completo (pré-agendamento → consulta → fechamento → pós-venda → fidelização).
  • Acompanhar diariamente os indicadores de performance : agendamentos, conversões, faturamento e upsell.
  • Criar e executar estratégias de recall e reativação de pacientes , principalmente nos períodos de menor fluxo.
  • Garantir o uso correto dos roteiros e processos comerciais padronizados no Kommo e demais sistemas.
  • Validar todos os orçamentos antes do envio ao paciente e acompanhar o fechamento financeiro junto ao time comercial.
2. Gestão de Equipe
  • Liderar e desenvolver os times de Comercial 1, Comercial 2, Sucesso do Cliente e Pós-venda .
  • Realizar reuniões semanais de alinhamento e resultado , com foco em metas e plano de ação.
  • Monitorar o desempenho individual, fornecendo feedbacks e treinamentos de melhoria contínua.
  • Incentivar a cultura de colaboração, comprometimento e entrega de resultados.
3. Parcerias Estratégicas
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar parcerias comerciais e institucionais com empresas, academias, salões, influenciadores, laboratórios, e profissionais da área da saúde e estética.
  • Criar ações de co-branding e indicação mútua , fortalecendo o posicionamento premium da marca.
  • Acompanhar os resultados de cada parceria (número de leads gerados, conversões, faturamento e retorno de imagem).
  • Garantir que todas as parcerias estejam alinhadas à visão, valores e público-alvo da Elite Clinic.
  • Apresentar relatórios mensais de performance de parcerias à diretoria médica, com análise de ROI e plano de expansão.
4. Integração Estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o marketing , acompanhando a performance das campanhas e qualidade dos leads.
  • Participar das definições de metas comerciais e campanhas sazonais com a diretoria médica.
  • Garantir a integração entre recepção, enfermagem e equipe médica , evitando falhas na jornada do paciente.
  • Auxiliar na criação de campanhas internas e externas para aumento de vendas e engajamento.
5. Pós-venda e Fidelização
  • Supervisionar o acompanhamento pós-consulta e garantir a continuidade dos pacientes ativos.
  • Criar ações de fidelização e indicação (NPS, Google Review, programas de vantagens, vouchers e experiências).
  • Mapear oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell para protocolos complementares (laser, estética, implantes, soroterapia, nutrição, etc.).
INDICADORES DE DESEMPENHO (KPIs)
  • Taxa de conversão de leads → mínimo 60%
  • Taxa de fechamento de protocolos → mínimo 40%
  • Faturamento mensal → meta definida pela diretoria
  • Taxa de reativação de pacientes → mínimo 30%
  • Satisfação do paciente (NPS) → mínimo 90%
  • Retorno sobre parcerias (ROI) → mínimo 3x
COMPETÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS
  • Liderança inspiradora e foco em resultado
  • Comunicação clara e empática
  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica
  • Gestão de pessoas e negociação
  • Inteligência emocional e adaptabilidade
  • Networking e visão de negócios
REQUISITOS
  • Experiência anterior em gestão comercial de clínicas médicas, estética ou saúde premium.
  • Conhecimento em CRM (Kommo, RD Station, Pipedrive ou similares).
  • Habilidade com planilhas, metas e apresentações de resultado.
  • Vivência com gestão de parcerias, eventos e relacionamento B2B.
RELACIONAMENTO HIERÁRQUICO
  • Reporta-se diretamente à: Diretoria

  • Empresa Cidadã (Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendida) e outros.

Competências da SIG

Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós.

Nosso Compromisso

A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.

Sobre a SIG

A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor.

Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

title: Especialista Forense Digital
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional que terá como responabilidade Identificar, preservar, analisar e interpretar evidências digitais com rigor técnico, imparcialidade e aderência legal, sustentando investigações internas, judiciais e administrativas. Transformar dados e artefatos em materialidades tecnicamente robustas, assegurando cadeia de custódia, confiabilidade dos achados e subsídios claros para tomada de decisão e responsabilização.

Conheça nossa história:

A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação.

Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coleta e Preservação de Evidências: conduzir aquisição forense (imaging) de mídias e dispositivos (HD/SSD/SATA, Windows, Linux, mobile, cloud), garantindo integridade (hashing), lacração e registro detalhado da cadeia de custódia.
  • Análise Técnica Profunda: examinar sistemas de arquivos, artefatos de SO, logs, memória, dispositivos móveis e ambientes em nuvem; correlacionar eventos e reconstruir linhas do tempo de incidentes.
  • Elaboração de Laudos e Relatórios: produzir laudos técnicos e relatórios executivos claros, objetivos e fundamentados, com metodologia, evidências, achados, limitações e conclusões.
  • Conformidade e Boas Práticas: atuar conforme normas, procedimentos e requisitos legais aplicáveis, garantindo imparcialidade, reprodutibilidade e confidencialidade.
  • Gestão do Laboratório e Ferramentas: operar e manter ferramentas forenses (ex.: suites de análise, utilitários de extração e parsing), infraestrutura segura de armazenamento de evidências e políticas de descarte.
  • Apoio a Investigações e Auditorias: colaborar com Jurídico, GRC, Segurança da Informação e RH em investigações internas e processos disciplinares; participar de reuniões técnicas e briefings executivos.
